title: 第165章 伴生神器流光琴第1章 ＊＊＊＊＊
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
月临寒摇摇头，耐心地解释着，目光落在她身上，带着几分怜惜，“你是应天运而生，集天地灵气与我的心血所化，你身上不仅有我的神力，还有我的精血，是我耗尽半生修为，倾注了所有心血的至宝。”
他顿了顿，又补充道，“只是现在你的这具躯体太过脆弱，像一株娇嫩的幼苗，承受不住你所有的神魂力量，所以被我封印了起来。”
宁苒苒突然想到了什么，皓腕轻翻，指尖霎时萦绕起层层叠叠的潋滟流光，那光芒如月华倾泻，似碎钻流转，在她掌心盘旋汇聚。
不过须臾，一架通体似水晶琉璃雕琢而成的竖琴便缓缓凝形，琴身澄澈通透，宛如整块冰魄水晶打磨铸就，澄澈得能映出人影，又似盛满了流动的星河，每一寸纹路都流转着七彩光晕，瑰丽得令人移不开眼。
琴枋处雕刻着缠枝莲纹，花瓣脉络清晰可见，仿佛风一吹便会绽出芬芳。琴轸是深海珍珠所制，莹白圆润，透着温润的光泽。那琴弦更是绝妙，细如发丝，却泛着金银双色的流光，轻颤间，便有清越空灵的琴音袅袅散开，余韵悠长。
流光琴自掌心浮起，由寸许大小悠悠涨至半人高，琴身银辉流转间轻轻晃荡，细碎如星子的光点簌簌洒落，像揉碎了一捧月光，落在地上便化作转瞬即逝的莹蓝流萤。
待光芒敛尽，琴身稳稳立于青砖之上，弦柱似冰棱剔透，琴面纹路如冰川裂谷般蜿蜒，尾端坠着的琉璃流苏轻垂，风过无声，宛如一件集天地灵气于一体的绝世艺术品，甫一出现，周遭喧嚣仿佛被尽数涤荡，连空气都染上了几分清灵雅致的气息。
“你说的伴生神器——”宁苒苒侧过头，粉蓝色的发梢拂过肩头，目光里满是难以置信，看向身侧的月临寒：“是这个？”
月临寒一袭素白长袍，衣袂无风自动，他微微颔首，清冷的声线里难得带了几分柔和：“不错。”
宁苒苒缓步上前，指尖轻轻抚过琴身微凉的纹路，触感细腻如玉石，她低声呢喃，语气里带着几分怅然：“这架琴跟着我这么多年了，我却始终不知道该怎么使用它，平日里摸上去冷冰冰的，宛如死物。”
她顿了顿，嘴角牵起一抹自嘲的笑：“我还以为，它就是个装饰呢……”
“不是。”月临寒也凑近了些，与宁苒苒并肩而立，目光落在流光琴繁复的雕花上，缓缓道：“只是它当初破开空间壁垒，把你从另一个世界带到这里，历经时空乱流的撕扯，损伤严重，这才陷入了沉睡。”
“那我该怎么做？”宁苒苒猛地抬头，眼底燃起几分希冀，又很快黯淡下去，她知道这等上古神器的修复，从来不是一朝一夕的事。
月临寒转头看她，墨色的眸子里映着琴身的光：“我也不知道，或许一年，或许三年，又或者，要等十年二十年……”
宁苒苒却没有半分失落，反而伸出双手，轻轻环住了冰凉的琴身，指尖的温度一点点熨帖上去，声音温柔得能滴出水来：“没关系，我相信等它养好伤，总会醒过来的，我会等着它醒过来的。”
她顿了顿，语气里满是感激：“还要谢谢它，当年救了我，将我带到这个世界。”
话音刚落，琴身忽然传来一阵极轻微的震颤，细弱得仿佛风吹过发丝，转瞬即逝。若不是宁苒苒此刻正将脸颊贴在琴面上，恐怕真要以为是错觉。
“看！”她猛地抬起头，眼底迸发出惊喜的光芒，声音都带上了几分颤抖：“它刚刚好像是在回应我呢！它果然听得到！”
月临寒看着她雀跃的模样，清冷的眉眼间也染上了一丝笑意。
宁苒苒小心翼翼地收回了覆在琴身上的武魂，又扭头看向月临寒，疑惑道：“对了，我的《九魄流光决》，是流光琴自带的功法吗？”

月临寒摇了摇头，月光落在他白皙的侧脸，勾勒出清隽的轮廓：“不是，这其实是我为你量身打造的功法，最贴合你的体质和武魂路数，好好练吧，我等着看你的成长。”
宁苒苒闻言，心里暖烘烘的，可下一秒，她又想起了那些日渐模糊的记忆碎片，眼神倏地黯淡下来。
宁苒苒声音里带着难以掩饰的哀伤：“如果……如果我不想忘记前世的记忆，我该怎么办？我还能怎么办？”她抬眸看向月临寒，眼底水光潋滟，像藏着一汪快要溢出的泪。
月临寒愣了愣，垂在身侧的手指微微蜷缩，他沉默了片刻，忽然抬手指了指不远处的屋子，声音低沉：“或许，你可以试试远离他们……”
宁苒苒顺着他的目光望去，只见屋里的人还保持着方才的动作，唐三正抬手欲将茶杯递到唇边，宁荣荣托着腮帮子，眼神亮晶晶地望着窗外，奥斯卡手里还捏着半块香肠——时间被月临寒定格，所有人都像被施了定身咒一般，凝固在这一刻，静谧得有些诡异。
这下轮到宁苒苒沉默了。她看着屋里那些熟悉的面孔，心脏像是被一只无形的手攥紧，连呼吸都变得有些困难。
“这群少年，运气胜过大陆上绝大多数人。换个说法就是，他们也算是这片大陆的气运之子了。”
月临寒的灵体缓缓飘起，落在唐三面前，目光深邃，他顿了顿，语气带着几分叹服：“特别是他，这个人的气运，是我生平所见最强的，气运越强的人，他的未来便越是模糊难测。”
“而你的记忆，”月临寒转头看向宁苒苒，声音里带着不容置疑的笃定，“跟气运越强的人待在一起的时间越久，消逝得就越快。”
“所以……”宁苒苒怔怔地开口，声音轻得像一片羽毛，“这就是为什么，我的记忆消失得这么快的原因？”
“没错。”月临寒点点头，目光里带着几分不忍，却还是将真相道破：“所以，你要不要离开他们的身边呢？”
content_en:
Yue Linhan shook her head and explained patiently, her eyes falling on her with a bit of pity, "You were born according to destiny, the aura of heaven and earth and my hard work. You not only have my divine power, but also my essence and blood. It is a treasure that I have spent half my life cultivating and poured all my efforts into."
He paused and then added, "It's just that your body is too fragile now, like a delicate seedling. It can't bear all the power of your soul, so I sealed it."
Ning Ranran suddenly thought of something. She flipped her wrist lightly, and layers of glimmering light suddenly appeared on her fingertips. The light poured down like moonlight, like broken diamonds, swirling and gathering in her palm.
However, after a moment, a harp whose entire body was carved from crystal glass slowly solidified. The body of the harp was clear and transparent, as if it were polished and cast from a whole piece of ice crystal. It was so clear that it could reflect the silhouette of a human figure, and it also seemed to be filled with flowing stars. Every inch of the lines was filled with colorful halos, making it so magnificent that people couldn't take their eyes away.
The qin fang is carved with a lotus pattern, and the veins of the petals are clearly visible, as if the fragrance will bloom when the wind blows. Qin Zhen is made of deep-sea pearls, which are white and round, with a warm luster. The strings are even more exquisite, as thin as hair, but glowing with gold and silver. As they vibrate, the clear and ethereal sound of the piano spreads out, with a long aftertaste.
The liuguangqin floated from the palm of my hand, slowly growing from a size of about an inch to half a person's height. The silvery light on the piano body swayed gently, and light spots as fine as stars scattered, like a handful of moonlight crushed into pieces. When they fell on the ground, they turned into fleeting blue fireflies.
When the light faded away, the piano body stood firmly on the blue bricks. The string pillars were as clear as ice, and the texture on the piano surface was as winding as a glacier rift. The glazed tassel hanging from the end hung lightly, making no sound in the wind. It was like a unique work of art that integrated the aura of heaven and earth. As soon as it appeared, the surrounding noise seemed to be washed away, and even the air was dyed with a clear and elegant atmosphere.
"The companion artifact you are talking about——" Ning Ranran turned her head, her pink-blue hair brushed over her shoulders, her eyes were full of disbelief, and she looked at Yue Linhan beside her: "Is this it?"
Yue Linhan was dressed in a plain white robe, and the clothes were windless. He nodded slightly and said with a rare softness in his cold voice: "Not bad."
Ning Ranran stepped forward slowly, and her fingertips gently touched the cool lines of the piano body. The touch was as delicate as jade. She murmured in a low voice, with a hint of sadness in her tone: "This piano has been with me for so many years, but I still don't know how to use it. It feels cold to the touch, like a dead thing."
She paused, with a self-deprecating smile on her lips: "I thought it was just a decoration..."
"No." Yue Linhan also came closer, standing side by side with Ning Ranran, her eyes fell on the complicated carvings of the Streamer, and said slowly: "It's just that it broke the space barrier and brought you here from another world. After being torn apart by the turbulent flow of time and space, it was seriously damaged and fell into a deep sleep."
"Then what should I do?" Ning Ranran raised her head suddenly, her eyes ignited with hope, but then quickly dimmed. She knew that the restoration of ancient artifacts never happened overnight.
Yue Linhan turned to look at her, her dark eyes reflecting the light of the piano body: "I don't know, maybe one year, maybe three years, or maybe it will take ten or twenty years..."
Ning Ranran was not disappointed at all. Instead, she stretched out her hands and gently hugged the cold body of the piano. The warmth of her fingertips pressed against it little by little, and her voice was so gentle that it could drip water: "It doesn't matter. I believe that it will wake up after it recovers from its injuries. I will wait for it to wake up."
She paused, her tone full of gratitude: "I also want to thank it for saving me and bringing me to this world."
As soon as he finished speaking, a very slight tremor suddenly came from the piano body, as weak as the wind blowing through the hair, and it disappeared in an instant. If Ning Ranran hadn't pressed her cheek against the piano at this moment, I might have thought it was an illusion..
"Look!" She raised her head suddenly, her eyes sparkling with surprise, and her voice was trembling: "It seemed to be responding to me just now! It really could hear it!"
Yue Linhan looked at her cheerful expression, and a hint of smile appeared on her cold brows.
Ning Ranran carefully withdrew the martial spirit covering Qin's body, then turned to look at Yue Linhan, wondering: "By the way, is my "Nine Souls Liuguang Jue" a skill that comes with Liuguang Qin?"
Yue Linhan shook his head. The moonlight fell on his fair side face, outlining Qing Jun's outline: "No, this is actually a technique I tailor-made for you. It best suits your physique and martial arts path. Practice it well. I'm waiting to see your growth."
Ning Ranran felt warm in her heart when she heard this, but the next second, she thought of those increasingly blurred memory fragments again, and her eyes suddenly dimmed.
There was unconcealable sadness in Ning Ranran's voice: "If...if I don't want to forget the memory of my previous life, what should I do? What else can I do?" She raised her eyes to look at Yue Linhan, her eyes filled with water, as if she was hiding a pool of tears that were about to overflow.
Yue Linhan was stunned for a moment, and the fingers hanging by his side curled up slightly. He was silent for a moment, then suddenly raised his finger and pointed at the house not far away, and said in a low voice: "Perhaps, you can try to stay away from them..."
Ning Ranran followed his gaze and saw that the people in the room were still maintaining the same movements as before. Tang San was raising his hand to pass the tea cup to his lips. Ning Rongrong was holding her cheek and looking out the window with bright eyes. Oscar was still holding half a piece of sausage in his hand - time was frozen by the cold moon, and everyone seemed to have been cast a holding spell. They were frozen in this moment, and it was strangely quiet.
This time it was Ning Ranran's turn to be silent. She looked at the familiar faces in the room, her heart seemed to be clenched by an invisible hand, and even breathing became a little difficult.
"This group of young people are luckier than most people on the continent. In other words, they can be regarded as the children of luck in this continent."
Yue Linhan's spirit body slowly floated up and landed in front of Tang San. His gaze was deep. He paused and said with a hint of admiration in his tone: "Especially him, this person's luck is the strongest I have ever seen in my life. The stronger the luck of a person, the more ambiguous and unpredictable his future will be."
"And your memory," Yue Linhan turned to look at Ning Ranran, with unquestionable certainty in her voice, "the longer you stay with someone with stronger luck, the faster it will fade away."
"So..." Ning Ranran said in a daze, her voice as light as a feather, "Is this why my memory disappeared so quickly?"
"That's right." Yue Linhan nodded, with a bit of unbearable look in his eyes, but still told the truth: "So, do you want to leave their side?"
